resources.string: To silence notifications, place your phone face down on a flat surface. You\'ll feel a subtle vibration each time Pssst turns on.
Allow access to Do Not Disturb
To turn on Pssst, open your device\'s settings below, then turn on the switch next to Pssst.
Pssst needs Do Not Disturb access. Tap the switch to grant it.
When the phone lies face down
Required by Android so Pssst can watch the sensors in the background.
Flip your phone to silence it
This gesture turns on Do Not Disturb and stops most interruptions
The sensor hub detects face down, like Flip to Shhh on Pixel. Pssst\'s own sensor readout is off.
Install the Magisk module so the sensor hub can detect face down. More reliable with the screen off and easier on the battery.
Module installed. Restart your phone to use the sensor hub.
Module removed. Restart your phone to finish.
The Flip to Shhh nanoapp is not available on this phone. Pssst uses its own sensors.
Allow root access for Pssst in Magisk to set up the sensor hub.
The sensor hub setup needs Magisk.
That did not work. Check that Pssst has root access in Magisk.
